items.reason: Gap 0 describes two overlapping deliveries both checking the set before either records the id, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 1 says the dedup key is read from the X-Event-Id header, which the provider calls an unsigned copy of the signed body id.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are swallowed.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
